about: P52 T2 dev set: 40 sentences written 2026-10-18 for the gaps P47B left (plan Fakta), two per gap plus six enemy-verb traps. `gap` = the gap the sentence aims at, `wants` = hero actions in sentence order (hand label; [] = the verb belongs to an enemy). Tuning and diagnosis run here, on `p47b/verb-dev.json` and on the P46A sentences – never on `holdout.json`.
